notes:
Three findings that punished the reader for doing it right.

**A 500 in your sitemap is not a stale entry.** Sitemap URLs returning a server
error were reported as broken links to regenerate around. Doing that deletes the
entries and hides the fault. Those URLs are now reported only by the check that
owns them, which tells you to read the server logs.

**A more specific business type is still a business.** Sites using
`ProfessionalService`, `Restaurant`, `NGO` or any other schema.org business
subtype were told their markup had no `sameAs` profile links even when it had
several. Every identity subtype is now read the same way as `Organization`.

**Colour advice no longer flattens an elevation ramp.** Near-identical colours
that are deliberate steps of a surface ramp were reported as brand drift, with
instructions to collapse them into one. The finding still reports what it
measured; the advice now says plainly that Docket cannot tell a ramp from the
same colour written twice.
